title: Practice 2: Someone who does or is something

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **слушатель** — слу́шатель: listener, hearer, audience (someone who listens); student. Wiktionary: слу́шать + -тель.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **сле́дователь** — (law enforcement) investigator, detective. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**следователь** — сле́дователь: (law enforcement) investigator, detective. Wiktionary: сле́довать + -тель.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: писа́тель — writer; слу́шатель — listener, hearer, audience (someone who listens); сле́дователь — (law enforcement) investigator, detective; представи́тель — representative.
**представи́тель** — representative. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **учитель** — teacher, instructor. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **покрови́тель** — patron, protector, sponsor. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: St. Patrick is the patron saint of Ireland.
exercises.why: **покровитель** — покрови́тель: patron, protector, sponsor. Wiktionary: покрыть + -тель.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **роди́тель** — parent. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: учитель — teacher, instructor; покрови́тель — patron, protector, sponsor; роди́тель — parent; после́дователь — follower.
